name: us021-state-tasks-appeared
description: T021a [US2]: reconcile a three-story specification to completion (no tasks.md present), then let tasks.md appear before the second reconcile. data-model.md §1 'inputs members': tasks.md's key is omitted entirely while absent, so its appearance changes the inputs map and contracts/run-state.md §3's 'an input appeared/disappeared' row applies — the second run must be a full reconcile, and the freshly recorded state's inputs must carry a tasks.md key.
